faqs.a1: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open standard that enables AI assistants to securely connect to external data sources and tools.
faqs.q2: How do I install an MCP server?
faqs.a2: Copy the MCP config JSON and add it to your Claude Desktop or Cursor settings file, then restart the application.
faqs.q3: How do I submit an MCP server?
faqs.a3: Click Submit MCP in the navigation bar, fill in the required information, and submit for review.
faqs.a4: Claude Desktop, Cursor IDE, and other MCP-compatible clients support MCP servers.
faqs.a5: Yes, MCP is an open standard. Most MCP servers are free and open source.
faqs.q6: How do I create my own MCP server?
faqs.a6: Use the official MCP SDK for TypeScript or Python to build your own server.
